scripts.types: npm run check:wrangler-pin && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:wrangler-pin && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test test/auth.test.ts test/http.test.ts test/oauth.test.ts test/geo.test.ts test/bundle-inputs.test.ts test/check-tenant-isolation.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint:tenant && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:tenant && npm run build && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:wrangler-pin: node -e "const want=require('./package.json').devDependencies.wrangler;let got=null;try{got=require('wrangler/package.json').version}catch{}if(got===want)process.exit(0);console.error('\\nwrangler '+(got||'not installed')+' resolved, but '+want+' is pinned.\\n'+'Run: npm ci --prefix hosted/knowledge-mcp\\n'+'Do NOT regenerate the types to make this go away. A different wrangler bundles a different '+'workerd, so regenerating REPLACES worker-configuration.d.ts with stale runtime types -- '+'thousands of deletions -- while looking like a routine fix. If you ever do regenerate, '+'read git diff --stat before committing.\\n');process.exit(1)"
